import sqlite3
import csv
import sys

def export_users_to_csv(db_path, output_file, user_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Query users based on provided ID
    query = "SELECT id, name, email, phone FROM users WHERE id = " + str(user_id)
    cursor.execute(query)
    
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    
    # Write to CSV
    with open(output_file, 'w', newline='') as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(['ID', 'Name', 'Email', 'Phone'])
        writer.writerows(rows)
    
    conn.close()
    print(f"Exported {len(rows)} records to {output_file}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    db_path = "company.db"
    output_file = "users_report.csv"
    user_id = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1
    
    export_users_to_csv(db_path, output_file, user_id)
